_source.meaning: Per county FIPS, lists of block groups (the 7 digits after the county FIPS) whose value is not the block group's own published ACS estimate. hv_tract / rent_tract: the block group's estimate is not published and the value is the surrounding tract's published median. hv_mismatch / rent_mismatch: equals neither (a data error, see docs/audit/acs-fallback-flags.md). A block group not listed holds its own estimate (or has no value). Los Angeles: rent only (its home values are assessor-based).
